purpose: Machine-readable theorem/claim registry: one file per claim under claims/, with the shared vocabularies here. Use dependencies/implies as a theorem dependency graph; resolve a branch with `python py/registry.py show <ID> --deps --proof` rather than reading the directory linearly. Indexes are generated by `py/registry.py reindex`, never hand-maintained.

status_definitions.bridge: Direct synthesis or translation of established results into ScoreQuant notation/problem.
status_definitions.project_proved: Derived in the project and currently treated as proved internally; not yet publication-audited.
status_definitions.counterexample: An explicit example falsifies the stated/generalized claim.
status_definitions.measured: Supported by empirical/regression evidence only (see NUMERICAL_EVIDENCE.md); not a proof.

publication_status_definitions.published: Result is attributed to external published literature.
publication_status_definitions.internal: Internal project result; requires external proof/prior-art audit.

literature_search_status_definitions.not_searched: No targeted prior-art search has been run for this claim.
literature_search_status_definitions.search_gap: Targeted prior-art search found no direct precedent; recorded in LITERATURE/; not a novelty claim.
literature_search_status_definitions.prior_art_found: Direct or near-direct precedent located; see the literature entry cited by the claim.

Li-Mathias-2000.title: Extremal Characterizations of the Schur Complement and Resulting Inequalities
Li-Mathias-2000.note: SIAM Review 42(2):233-246. Theorem 2.2 is the DS11 identity (Loewner-minimal generalized Schur complement with exact attainment set); attributed to M. G. Krein (1947) and Anderson's shorted operator (1971).

Valassi-2020.title: Optimising HEP parameter fits via Monte Carlo weight derivative regression
Valassi-2020.note: CHEP2019 proceedings (EPJ Web of Conferences). Local copy: papers/valassi_2020_weight_derivative_regression_arXiv2003.12853.pdf

CMS-2025.title: Development of systematic uncertainty-aware neural network trainings for binned-likelihood analyses at the LHC

Cranmer-Pavez-Louppe-2015.title: Approximating Likelihood Ratios with Calibrated Discriminative Classifiers

Alsing-Wandelt-2019.title: Nuisance Hardened Data Compression for Fast Likelihood-Free Inference

Graf-Luschgy-2000.title: Foundations of Quantization for Probability Distributions
Graf-Luschgy-2000.note: Springer LNM 1730. Every cell of an optimal quantizer has positive mass and null boundaries (content secondary-verified via Roychowdhury Prop 1.1 and Liu-Pages 2020, who pin the null-boundary statement to Thm 4.2 and existence to Thm 4.12; the "Thm 4.1" numbering for positive mass is unverified - 30 Aug 2026 audit); Thm 5.1: uniqueness of the scalar log-concave K-quantizer (numbering and content confirmed twice at secondary level).

Levrard-2015.title: Nonasymptotic bounds for vector quantization in Hilbert spaces
Levrard-2015.note: AOS 43(2):592-619. Definition 2.1 margin condition: p(t) <= (B p_min / 128 M^2) t on the mass of t-neighborhoods of optimal-cell boundaries - a hypothesis on the LAW at population optima, never proven at empirical optima; buys finite optimal-codebook sets, quadratic growth, and 1/n rates; Gaussian mixtures satisfy it. (arXiv 1405.6672; the earlier arXiv 1310.7138 "Margin conditions for vector quantization" is the 2013 precursor.)

Kieffer-1983.title: Uniqueness of locally optimal quantizer for log-concave density and convex error weighting function
Kieffer-1983.note: IEEE Trans. IT 29:42-47. Log-concave source + convex strictly increasing C1 error weight: unique locally optimal scalar quantizer (hence globally optimal); Gaussian covered. Secondary-verified via Kazikli et al. arXiv:2012.08265 Thm 3 and Liu-Pages-2020 Lemma 10.

Liu-Pages-2020.title: Convergence rate of optimal quantization and application to the clustering performance of the empirical measure
Liu-Pages-2020.note: JMLR 21(86):1-36. Lemma 10: strongly unimodal law has a unique stationary (hence optimal) scalar K-quantizer; Prop 11: positive-definite distortion Hessian at the optimum under strict log-concavity.

Garcia-Escudero-Gordaliza-1999.title: Robustness Properties of k Means and Trimmed k Means
Garcia-Escudero-Gordaliza-1999.note: JASA 94:956-969. k-means non-robustness: contamination drives a cluster to chase an outlier; trimming repairs it.

Hennig-2004.title: Breakdown points for maximum likelihood estimators of location-scale mixtures
Hennig-2004.note: Ann. Statist. 32:1313-1340. A far-enough added point forms a one-point cluster at the exact fixed-K clustering optimum (secondary-verified via Hennig arXiv:2308.14478).

Wang-Yang-Stufken-2019.title: Information-Based Optimal Subdata Selection for Big Data Linear Regression
Wang-Yang-Stufken-2019.note: D-determinant over an i.i.d. sample is maximized by extreme order statistics; per-point information scale 2 log n for normal covariates (Thm 2, 6).

Sibson-Kenny-1975.title: Coefficients in D-Optimal Experimental Design
Sibson-Kenny-1975.note: JRSS-B 37:288-292. With Atwood's inequality: D-optimal design weights are bounded ABOVE by 1/k; no published lower bound found.

Silvey-1978.title: Optimal design measures with singular information matrices
Silvey-1978.note: Biometrika 65:553-559 (secondary-verified). Ds-optimal designs can carry singular full information matrices - the design-side analogue of the (M3) failure at Ds-optimal partitions (DS15).

Fisher-1958.title: On Grouping for Maximum Homogeneity
Fisher-1958.note: JASA 53(284):789-798 (verbatim-verified 30 Aug 2026). Optimal 1-D weighted SSE partitions are contiguous (appendix proof); reduction to C(K-1,G-1) contiguous partitions - the classical anchor for the scalar interval optimum and exact DP step (DS8, DS15 Proposition 4). Credits the continuous analogue to Dalenius 1950 and Cox 1957.

Mease-Nair-2006.title: Unique optimal partitions of distributions and connections to hazard rates and stochastic ordering
Mease-Nair-2006.note: Statistica Sinica 16:1299-1312 (verbatim-verified 30 Aug 2026). Confirms scalar-quantizer uniqueness under log-concavity of the density via likelihood-ratio ordering, and refutes Eubank-1988 weaker sufficient condition by an explicit three-stationary-solution counterexample: DS15 assumption (S) must stay pinned to log-concavity of the density itself.

Blanchard-Jaffe-Zhivotovskiy-2025.title: Consistency and inconsistency in k-means clustering
Blanchard-Jaffe-Zhivotovskiy-2025.note: Empirical k-means centers can fail to converge under finite first moment even with a unique population optimum (extreme cluster imbalance); consistency restored by an a priori balance constraint. Closest published structure to DS15 Proposition 6 (constraints at negligible asymptotic cost), but repairs a moment pathology rather than the optimizer-driven degeneracy DS15 proves; scalar distortion only. Engage before publication.

read_order: README.md defines the single canonical read order; follow it rather than any local copy.
rules: Resolve a claim with `python py/registry.py show <ID> --deps --proof`.
Browse claims/INDEX.md (generated) to pick work; it is grouped by programme in queue order.
Never hand-edit an index; run `python py/registry.py reindex`.
Run `python py/registry.py validate` before finishing a session.
